term: possible guarded causal count and its decrement interface
definition: PossibleCount h Concrete CauseCount w n supplies a world v accessible from w and CausedThreshold at v for n. FiveThresholdPossible is that predicate at 5; ThresholdDescent is existing CountDescent applied to this predicate. Different n may have different worlds, individuals and causal histories; no joint realization, fixed cause or monotonicity follows. The supplied concrete predicate is world-invariant and not automatically materiality or the legacy intervention-response capacity.
note: The typed five and descent inputs remain OPEN framework commitments. They are distinct from the old sourced statements over an uninterpreted Nat-to-Prop parameter. Arithmetic weakening of a cardinal bound does not preserve causal pre-target absence. No universal PSR or actual causal explanation is inferred.
